newsitem.title: USA: Koo Koo Roo names execs to new posts.
newsitem.headline: Koo Koo Roo names execs to new posts.

text.p: Koo Koo Roo Inc Thursday said it named three top executives to plan and implement the company's expansion in the U.S. and abroad.

The Los Angeles-based restaurant chain named John Kaufman, 35, to the post of president and chief operating officer of Koo Koo Roo Inc USA. The company said Michael Mooslin, 49, most recently president and chief operating officer of Koo Koo Roo USA, has been named president and chief operating officer of Koo Koo Roo International. Robert Kautz, 38, chief financial officer, retains his title while being named as president of corporate development.
Kaufman was formerly vice president of operations at California Pizza Kitchen Restaurants.
